about.zuugle_erklaerung_1: Zuugle is a search engine for hikes that can be reached by public transport.
about.zuugle_erklaerung_2: Zuugle offers the unique possibility of not only finding mountain tours but also how to get to them by public transport. Zuugle uses predefined criteria to look for available mountain tours on the internet and filters for those that are accessible by public transport. Since most tours do not start and end directly at a public transport stop, Zuugle also gives walking directions.
about.wie_und_wofuer: HOW AND WHAT CAN I USE ZUUGLE FOR?
about.entwicklung_von_zuugle_1: When developing Zuugle, we particularly focused on ease of use and clear presentation, so that you can find the right hikes for you with just a few clicks.
about.entwicklung_von_zuugle_2: Since Zuugle is a search engine, there is obviously a search bar on the homepage, divided into two parts. On the left you enter the place from which you want to travel. The righthand part is optional, for seeking specific mountain groups, sports or certain search words (e.g. "Gastein" or "Wachau"). The results of your search can now be displayed.
about.entwicklung_von_zuugle_3: On the results page, you can further refine your search with various filters, e.g. regarding arrival time, degree of difficulty, altitude difference and much more. In this way, you will find the tour that suits your current wishes.
about.entwicklung_von_zuugle_4: Now click on your desired tour. A tour description will appear on your screen, which you can also download as a PDF. For the Zuugle timetable suggestions for the next 7 days, click on the "Arrival & Departure" tab. Zuugle selects the best outward journey and shows you several return options.
about.entwicklung_von_zuugle_5: Please note that train cancellations or timetable changes at short notice may not be taken into account by our timetable suggestions. Therefore, please check your connection with the respective operators (bahn.de, oebb.at) before starting your journey. Click on the button of the tour portal to open a new window with the detailed tour description in the respective portal.

impressum.beschreibungen_fotos: The descriptions and photos of the individual mountain tours come from the respective linked tour portals. All information is provided without guarantee and "Bahn zum Berg" accepts no liability for its accuracy. The use of all content on this portal is therefore at your own risk and responsibility.
impressum.verknuepfung_links: This search engine for public transport tours contains links to third-party websites ("external links"). These websites are the responsibility of the respective operators. When we first created the external links to the third-party content, we checked whether there were any legal violations. At that time, no legal violations were apparent. However, we have no influence whatsoever on the current and future design and content of the linked pages. The inclusion of external links does not imply that we adopt the content behind the link as our own. Due to the large number of external links, it is not reasonable for us to constantly monitor them without concrete evidence of legal violations. However, we will delete such external links immediately if we become aware of any legal violations.

privacy.datenschutz_ist_uns_wichtig: Data protection is important to us. Therefore, we have rejected many options that are technically possible but would invade the privacy of our visitors.
privacy.welche_personenbezogenen_daten: WHAT DATA WE STORE AND WHY
privacy.ueberblick: You do not need an account to use Zuugle: we ask for neither your name nor your email address. Only two things are stored — anonymised usage statistics and, if you use the feature, the tours you have saved. Both are described in detail below.
privacy.matomo_2: in the self-hosted version. The data are therefore located on a server in Germany in the EU
privacy.abgespeichert_werden: The name of the website accessed, the time and the first two segments of the IP address are stored. It is not possible to track a specific person from such data.
privacy.cookies_erklaerung1: Zuugle stores a few settings directly in your browser rather than on our server. The language you picked and your cookie choice itself are technically necessary. Optional are the convenience features — such as remembering your departure location for the next connection search — and the usage statistics.
privacy.cookies_erklaerung2: We only start those optional features once you choose “Accept all” in the banner. If you choose “Technically necessary cookies only”, they stay off and any convenience data already stored is deleted from your browser. Your choice itself is likewise kept only in your browser: to change it, delete Zuugle's site data in your browser and we will ask you again on your next visit.
privacy.favoriten_1: When you save a tour, we create a list for it on our server. It holds only the saved tours, the time you saved them, and the language and Zuugle country site you are using. The list is tied to a randomly generated key that is stored in your browser. We do not know who you are and cannot link a list to a name, an email address or an IP address. If you never save a tour, nothing is created for you.
privacy.favoriten_2: You can bring your saved tours over to a second device. Zuugle shows a short code for this — also as a QR code — which is valid for ten minutes and can only be used once. Once it is redeemed, the favourites of both devices are permanently merged into one shared list: from then on both devices see the same tours, including every tour saved later. This cannot be undone. So only pass the code on to devices and people you really want to share your list with.
privacy.favoriten_3: If you remove a tour from your favourites again, it is deleted from the list on our server straight away. If you delete Zuugle's site data in your browser, that device loses the key and starts with an empty list; a second device that is still connected keeps the list.
privacy.mit_wem_daten_teilen: WITH WHOM WE SHARE YOUR DATA
privacy.mit_niemandem: With no one. We do not pass data on to third parties and we do not sell data. The only sharing that happens at all is the sharing you trigger yourself when you connect your favourites to another device.
privacy.wie_lange_daten_speichern: HOW LONG WE STORE YOUR DATA
privacy.cookie_verfall_drei_monate: After 3 months the cookie on your computer will expire.
privacy.favoriten_speicherdauer: A favourites list that has not been used for 24 months is deleted, together with the tours saved in it.
privacy.welche_rechte: WHAT RIGHTS YOU HAVE OVER YOUR DATA
privacy.rechte_auskunft: Because we do not run user accounts, we cannot identify you — and therefore cannot give anyone else information about you either. Everything we have stored about your saved tours is visible in your favourites view, and you can delete it there yourself. If you have any further question about your data, write to us at <0>kontakt [at] bahn-zum-berg.at</0>.
